question: Which of the following factors of soil formation determines the accumulation of the soil?
solution:
**The Correct answer is: Parent rock**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Parent Rock:**

 
 
• This is the **correct factor** that determines the accumulation of soil.
 
• The parent rock provides the **basic mineral composition** of the soil.
 
• Its nature (hard, soft, coarse-grained, or fine-grained) influences the **rate of weathering** and the type of soil formed.
 
• Soils derived from granite are sandy, while basalt produces black cotton soil rich in clay.
 
 
 
• **Fauna:**
 
 
• Animals, insects, and microorganisms help in mixing organic matter and improving soil aeration.
 
• They aid in soil fertility but do not determine the accumulation of the soil itself.
 
 
 
• **Flora:**
 
 
• Plants add humus and organic matter to the soil.
 
• They enrich the soil but do not decide the fundamental accumulation of soil material.
 
 
 
• **Relief:**
 
 
• Relief (slope and altitude) influences drainage and erosion.
 
• It affects soil depth and moisture but is not the primary determinant of accumulation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Factors of Soil Formation:**

 
 
• **Parent rock** – source of mineral matter.
 
• **Climate** – temperature and rainfall affect weathering and humus content.
 
• **Organisms** – flora and fauna add organic matter.
 
• **Relief** – slope and drainage determine soil depth and erosion.
 
• **Time** – longer duration allows mature soil profiles to develop.
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Alluvial soils in India are deposited by rivers and depend on the parent rock material carried from the Himalayas.
 
• Black soil of the Deccan Plateau is derived from basaltic parent rock.
